newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-IRISH JOCKEY BANNED AFTER DRUG TEST.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-IRISH JOCKEY BANNED AFTER DRUG TEST.

text.p: Irish jump jockey David Walsh, second in the Cheltenham Gold Cup in March on Barton Bank, was banned from riding for four weeks on Wednesday after failing a drug test.
The 22-year-old was referred to the Jockey Club's disciplinary committee when traces of amphetamines were discovered in a urine sample he gave at Huntingdon in February.
Walsh, who claimed he did not knowingly take any substance, will not be allowed to ride again until June 16.
